title: HLS Audio Sidecar Artifacts
problem: Nako can select HLS audio streams correctly, but cannot truthfully advertise alternate audio until generated audio-only HLS sidecar artifacts exist and are represented in the artifact manifest.

evidence.summary: Opened a durable lane for generated HLS audio sidecar artifacts after selected audio stream mapping became executable.
Added typed HLS audio rendition identity, default validation, and audio playlist/segment artifact membership.
Generated audio-only HLS sidecars through FFmpeg planning and published TYPE=AUDIO master playlist groups only for servable artifacts.
Verified focused gates, recorded evidence, and closed the workstream.

continue_policy.notes: The lane is closed. Follow-on work should open a new workstream for main-mux/audio-sidecar duplication removal, language preference defaults, codec-aware audio sidecars, or adaptive video-only variant cleanup.
